title: Storeama
tagline: Storeama is a decentralized storage platform on the Filecoin virtual network, it utilizes ipfs and a smart contract to store all kinds of filex, ranging from audio, video and documents
description: Storeama is a decentralized storage platform on the Filecoin virtual network, it utilizes ipfs and a smart contract to store all kinds of filex, ranging from audio, video and documents. Storeama helps organize and store files which can be accessed easily. Storeama is like google drive but for blockchain
how_its_made: Storeama smart contract is deployed to the filecoin virtual network, it's frontend is created using nextjs and the files are stored on ipfs. Storeama uses web3modal package to allow uses connect to a network. The smart contract is deployed to the wallaby test net and the testing stage was done on Remix
